source_row.rationale: Saddle anesthesia, bilateral leg weakness, and new bowel/bladder dysfunction in the context of severe back pain are red flag symptoms of cauda equina syndrome, a surgical emergency caused by compression of the cauda equina nerve roots, requiring immediate evaluation (MRI) and often emergency surgical decompression to prevent permanent neurological damage.
source_row.source_detail: Cauda equina red flags: urinary/bowel dysfunction and saddle anesthesia require urgent recognition/evaluation; current 2025/2026 StatPearls edition, accessed 2026-08-14.
